color_palette.name: Velodyne Parchment
color_palette.usage: Primary background across all pages and card surfaces — the warm cream base that gives the site its magazine-like, editorial breathing room. Used in hero overlays, section backgrounds, and card fills throughout the card grid.

color_palette.name: Peloton Black
color_palette.usage: Primary text color for all headings, body copy, and navigation. Also anchors the full-bleed hero panels, footer, and dark feature cards — the dominant typographic and structural ink of the system.

color_palette.name: Tarmac Charcoal
color_palette.usage: Secondary dark surface for mid-tone card backgrounds, stat blocks on the Performance page, and subtle rule lines between editorial sections. Provides depth without the full weight of Peloton Black.

color_palette.name: Chamois Warm
color_palette.usage: Warm neutral used for thin horizontal rules, card border strokes, disabled states, and secondary metadata text. Carries the editorial calm of a printed magazine gutter across article lists and athlete grid captions.

color_palette.name: Velodrome Gold
color_palette.usage: Primary accent for CTAs, active navigation states, badge borders, eyebrow labels on dark hero surfaces, and decorative rule accents. The team's prestige signal — appears on the Home CTA, Athletes card hover states, and Performance stat highlights.

color_palette.name: Sprint Ivory
color_palette.usage: Elevated card surface and page header background — a lighter step above Velodyne Parchment used to lift featured athlete cards, article list items, and the Contact block form area off the base background.

color_palette.name: Criterium Slate
color_palette.usage: Supporting text color for secondary body copy, captions, article metadata, and stat labels on the Performance page. Keeps long-form editorial readable without the full contrast weight of Peloton Black.

color_palette.name: Race Red
color_palette.usage: Selective accent reserved for urgency and energy moments — race result highlights, podium stat callouts on the Performance page, and hover-state underlines on Stories article headlines. Used sparingly to preserve the luxury register.

typography.heading_treatment: Playfair Display at display scale — H1 at 72–96px for hero headlines, H2 at 42–52px for section titles, H3 at 28–34px for card and article headings. All headings set in sentence case with tightly tracked display weight (font-weight 700–900), exploiting Playfair's extreme stroke contrast to evoke a premium cycling magazine masthead. Line-height kept tight at 1.05–1.15 for display sizes to create the asymmetric whitespace tension characteristic of luxury editorial layouts.
typography.body_treatment: Source Serif 4 at 16–18px with a generous 1.75 line-height and a comfortable measure of 62–68 characters. Used for all long-form editorial copy on Stories, Performance descriptions, athlete bios, and contact page prose. The optical-size axis should favor the 'text' optical size for body and the 'display' size for pull-quotes, maintaining the refined, magazine-like reading register throughout.
typography.accent_treatment: Montserrat in all-caps with 0.15–0.20em letter-spacing, set at 10–13px, exclusively for eyebrow labels above hero headlines, athlete card position tags, stat unit labels on the Performance page, article category badges, and navigation metadata. Never used at display or body scale — its role is the crisp, formal sans-serif counterpoint that grounds the serif system in precision and authority.

pages.page_level_design_instruction:
**Velodyne Home Page — Full Visual Design Direction**

**Page Role & Tone**
This is the landing page for Velodyne, an elite professional cycling race team. Every design decision must communicate prestige, competitive authority, and editorial refinement. The page should feel like opening a premium cycling magazine — not a startup marketing site. Cream and black dominate the surface language; Velodrome Gold is structural and expressive, not merely decorative.

**Section Sequence & Rhythm**
Three sections create a deliberate density arc: (1) a full-bleed, typographically dominant hero that commands the full viewport — maximum visual weight; (2) a modular card grid section with generous breathing room and editorial restraint — medium density; (3) a compact, high-contrast CTA close that is asymmetric and typographically bold — low density but high impact. The rhythm is LOUD → MEASURED → SHARP. No two sections share the same skeleton.

**Color & Surface Logic Across the Page**
- Section 1 (Hero): Peloton Black (#111010) full-bleed background. Velodrome Gold (#B89A3E) used expressively on the eyebrow and as a structural thin rule beneath the headline — not just on buttons. Sprint Ivory (#FAF7F2) for headline type to create maximum contrast against the black field.
- Section 2 (Feature Grid): Velodyne Parchment (#F2EDE4) base background — the magazine page breath. Cards sit on Sprint Ivory (#FAF7F2) with Chamois Warm (#D4C4A8) border strokes. Velodrome Gold used as a left-border accent rule on each card, not as a fill. Peloton Black for card headings; Criterium Slate (#5A5750) for card body copy.
- Section 3 (CTA): Tarmac Charcoal (#2C2B29) full-bleed background — a dark mid-tone that is distinct from the hero's pure black and the parchment grid section. Sprint Ivory for headline. Velodrome Gold for the primary CTA. This creates a DARK → LIGHT → DARK rhythm that avoids the predictable alternating-section trap.

**Typographic Hierarchy & Expressive Moves**
- Hero headline: Playfair Display at 88–96px, font-weight 900, Sprint Ivory, line-height 1.05. The word "Speed" is set at 20% larger than the rest of the headline line — an intentional weight-break that creates a typographic stunt. This is the page's SIGNATURE MOMENT (see below).
- Hero subheadline: Source Serif 4 at 18px, Chamois Warm (#D4C4A8), line-height 1.75, max-width ~600px, left-aligned.
- Feature grid section title: Playfair Display at 48px, Peloton Black, left-aligned with a Velodrome Gold thin rule (1px) running the full column width beneath it.
- Card headings: Playfair Display at 30px, Peloton Black, font-weight 700.
- Card body: Source Serif 4 at 16px, Criterium Slate, line-height 1.75.
- Eyebrows: Montserrat all-caps, 11px, letter-spacing 0.18em, Velodrome Gold throughout.
- CTA section headline: Playfair Display at 56px, Sprint Ivory, left-aligned. Deliberately NOT centered — asymmetric tension.

**The Page's Signature Moment**
The signature moment lives in the hero (Section 1): the word "Speed" in the headline "Forged in Speed. Defined by Excellence." is set at a dramatically larger size — approximately 120px vs. the surrounding 88px — creating a typographic rupture that breaks the grid. This oversized word bleeds slightly beyond the left text column into negative space, with a thin Velodrome Gold horizontal rule slicing through the composition beneath it, running edge-to-edge across the full viewport width. The effect is that of a luxury cycling magazine cover — editorial, authoritative, and unmistakably premium. No illustration or decorative element competes with it; the type IS the hero image.

**Signature Motion Moment**
On page load, the word "Speed" (the oversized display word) enters with a slow, deliberate vertical slide-up from 30px below its resting position while simultaneously fading in — arriving a beat after the eyebrow label has already settled. The Velodrome Gold rule beneath it draws itself left-to-right in a smooth wipe, as if being ruled by hand, completing just as "Speed" reaches its final position. This is the signature motion moment: it makes the typographic stunt feel earned, not static.

**Full Motion Design**

On-Load Arc (Hero, Section 1):
1. On page arrival, the full-bleed black background is already present — no fade-in on the surface itself.
2. The Montserrat eyebrow ("Professional Cycling" in Velodrome Gold) fades in first, from slight opacity 0 to full, taking about half a second.
3. A beat after the eyebrow settles, the headline begins: the non-"Speed" words slide up gently and fade in together.
4. The word "Speed" arrives a half-beat later with its own, slightly slower slide-up — the slight delay makes it feel like it carries more weight.
5. The Velodrome Gold horizontal rule draws itself left-to-right immediately after "Speed" lands, completing in about three-quarters of a second.
6. The subheadline fades in gently below, a full beat after the rule completes.
7. The two CTA buttons appear last, staggered by a quarter-beat each, with a subtle upward drift.

Scroll-Triggered Reveals:
- Section 2 (Feature Grid): As the section enters the viewport, the section eyebrow and headline fade and slide up first. The three cards then stagger in left-to-right, each with a subtle upward fade — approximately a quarter-beat apart. Cards do not scale; they simply arrive cleanly.
- Section 3 (CTA): The entire section fades in as a block with a gentle upward drift as it crosses the viewport threshold. No stagger — it reads as a single, composed statement.

Hover & Focus Affordances:
- Feature grid cards: On hover, the Velodrome Gold left-border rule thickens from 2px to 4px smoothly, and the card lifts 4px with a soft shadow deepening beneath it. The card heading shifts from Peloton Black to Velodrome Gold. Transition is quick — about 180ms.
- CTA buttons: Primary CTA (Velodrome Gold fill, Peloton Black label) inverts on hover to Peloton Black fill with Velodrome Gold label and border. Secondary CTA (ghost/outlined) fills with Sprint Ivory on hover. Both transitions are clean and fast — about 150ms.
- Navigation items: Velodrome Gold underline grows from 0 width to full width beneath the label on hover, animating left-to-right.

Ambient Looped Motion:
- A very slow, barely perceptible parallax drift on the hero background — the black field has a subtle grain or texture that drifts upward at roughly 10% of scroll speed, giving the hero a sense of depth without competing with the typography.
- The Velodrome Gold rule in the hero pulses with a very slow, low-amplitude opacity breath (between 85% and 100% opacity) on a gentle 4-second loop — restrained, magazine-like, not flashy.

**Density & Whitespace Logic**
- Hero: Dense typographically but sparse in terms of elements. The black field and the large type create tension through contrast, not crowding.
- Feature Grid: Generous padding above and below (120px vertical). Cards have 40px internal padding. Gutters between cards are 32px. The section feels like a magazine spread with room to breathe.
- CTA: Compact vertical height (roughly 280–320px). The asymmetric text placement and two CTAs on a single row keep it tight and decisive.

**Responsive Behavior**
- Hero: On tablet, the headline scales to 64px with "Speed" at ~84px. On mobile, headline scales to 44px with "Speed" at ~58px; the rule runs full-width. Subheadline drops to 16px. CTAs stack vertically.
- Feature Grid: Three-column card grid on desktop (1200px+). Two-column on tablet. Single-column stacked on mobile with full-width cards. The Velodrome Gold left-border rule remains on all breakpoints.
- CTA Section: Headline and CTAs remain left-aligned on all breakpoints. On mobile, CTAs stack vertically.

**Fit Within Shared Design System**
This page introduces and establishes the full palette and type system. Playfair Display at display scale is introduced at its most dramatic here (the hero). Montserrat eyebrows are established as the site's precision counterpoint. The Velodrome Gold rule-as-structural-device is introduced here and will recur as a system-wide motif on subsequent pages. The page does not use Race Red — that is reserved for performance data and race results on later pages, preserving its urgency signal.

section_design_plans.nl_prompt:
**Section 1 — Hero: Full-Bleed Typographic Cover**

Surface & Layout: The entire viewport is filled with Peloton Black (#111010). No photography, no illustration — the type IS the visual. This is a deliberate editorial move: the hero is a magazine cover, not a banner ad. The content area is constrained to a 12-column grid with a 120px left margin on desktop (intentionally left-weighted, not centered), giving the composition an asymmetric tension that is characteristic of luxury editorial design.

Eyebrow: Montserrat, all-caps, 11px, letter-spacing 0.18em, Velodrome Gold (#B89A3E). Positioned at the top-left of the text column, with 160px of vertical padding above it from the navigation bar. The eyebrow reads 'Professional Cycling.' It fades in first on page load — the first element the eye catches.

Headline — The Signature Moment: 'Forged in Speed. Defined by Excellence.' set in Playfair Display. 'Forged in' is set at 88px, font-weight 900, Sprint Ivory (#FAF7F2). The word 'Speed.' is set at 120px — dramatically larger, breaking the baseline grid — and its left edge aligns to the same text column margin while its sheer scale pushes it toward the right edge of the text column, creating a typographic rupture. 'Defined by Excellence.' returns to 88px on the line below. Line-height is 1.05 throughout. The scale contrast between 'Speed' and the surrounding words is the page's signature visual moment: it reads like a masthead, not a tagline. No other element on the page competes with this move.

Velodrome Gold Rule: Immediately beneath the last line of the headline, a 1px horizontal rule in Velodrome Gold (#B89A3E) runs the full viewport width — edge to edge, ignoring the text column margins. This rule is structural: it separates the headline from the subheadline and reinforces the magazine-layout aesthetic. On page load, it draws itself left-to-right in a smooth wipe, completing just as 'Speed' finishes its entrance animation. This is the signature motion moment.

Subheadline: Source Serif 4, 18px, Chamois Warm (#D4C4A8), line-height 1.75, max-width 580px, left-aligned within the text column. 28px of vertical space below the gold rule. The Chamois Warm color on the dark background reads as a warm secondary tone — not white, not gray, but editorial. Text: 'Velodyne competes at the highest level of road cycling — from Grand Tours to one-day classics — driven by precision training, elite athletes, and an uncompromising pursuit of the podium.' It fades in gently a full beat after the gold rule completes its draw.

CTAs: Two buttons placed in a horizontal row, 40px below the subheadline, left-aligned. Primary CTA: 'Meet the Athletes' — Velodrome Gold (#B89A3E) fill, Peloton Black (#111010) label in Montserrat all-caps 11px, letter-spacing 0.15em, 48px height, 32px horizontal padding. Secondary CTA: 'Follow Our Season' — transparent fill, 1px Sprint Ivory (#FAF7F2) border, Sprint Ivory label, same Montserrat treatment. On hover, the primary CTA inverts: Peloton Black fill, Velodrome Gold label and border (150ms transition). The secondary CTA fills with Sprint Ivory at 10% opacity on hover. The two CTAs stagger in on page load — the primary arrives first, then the secondary a quarter-beat later, both with a subtle upward drift from 12px below their resting positions.

Spacing & Padding: 160px top padding (below nav), 120px bottom padding. The overall vertical height of the hero is the full viewport height (100vh) — the CTAs sit comfortably above the fold with room to breathe below.

Ambient Motion: A very slow, barely perceptible grain/texture on the Peloton Black background drifts upward at roughly 10% of scroll speed, creating a sense of depth without competing with the type. The Velodrome Gold rule pulses with a very slow, low-amplitude opacity breath (85%–100%) on a 4-second loop — restrained and almost subliminal.

Responsive: On tablet (768–1199px), headline scales to 64px with 'Speed' at 84px; left margin reduces to 64px. On mobile (<768px), headline scales to 40px with 'Speed' at 54px; left margin reduces to 24px; CTAs stack vertically with full width. The gold rule always runs full viewport width.

**Section 2 — Feature Grid: Three Pillars Card Layout**

Surface & Background: Velodyne Parchment (#F2EDE4) — the warm cream base. This is the first time the page breathes after the intensity of the black hero. The tonal shift from Peloton Black to Parchment is immediate and intentional: it reads like turning a page in a magazine.

Section Header: Left-aligned within the 12-column grid, occupying columns 1–8 on desktop. Eyebrow: Montserrat all-caps, 11px, letter-spacing 0.18em, Velodrome Gold (#B89A3E), reading 'What Drives Us.' Section headline: 'Three Pillars of a Winning Team' in Playfair Display, 48px, font-weight 700, Peloton Black (#111010). Immediately beneath the headline, a 1px Velodrome Gold (#B89A3E) horizontal rule runs the full width of columns 1–8 (not full viewport width — this is a contained, editorial rule, different in scope from the hero's full-bleed rule). The rule appears 8px below the headline baseline. 16px of space below the rule before the card grid begins. No subheadline — the cards speak for themselves.

Card Grid: Three cards in a row on desktop, each occupying 4 columns with 32px gutters. Cards sit on Sprint Ivory (#FAF7F2) — a lighter step above the Parchment base, lifting them visually off the page surface. Each card has 40px internal padding on all sides. A 2px Velodrome Gold (#B89A3E) left-border rule runs the full height of each card's left edge — this is the primary accent treatment for the card, not a fill or background. Chamois Warm (#D4C4A8) provides a 1px border on the remaining three sides (top, right, bottom) — thin, magazine-like, not boxy.

Card Content:
- Card 1: 'Elite Roster' — Playfair Display, 30px, font-weight 700, Peloton Black (#111010). Body: Source Serif 4, 16px, Criterium Slate (#5A5750), line-height 1.75. 'A squad of world-ranked climbers, sprinters, and all-rounders selected for their exceptional talent and competitive record.'
- Card 2: 'Data-Driven Performance' — same typographic treatment. Body: 'Every watt, every kilometer, every recovery metric is analyzed to give our riders the competitive edge on race day.'
- Card 3: 'A Legacy of Victories' — same treatment. Body: 'From Grand Tour stage wins to monument podiums, Velodyne's palmares speaks for itself across the world's most prestigious races.'

Card Hover Motion: On hover, the Velodrome Gold left-border rule thickens from 2px to 4px in a smooth 180ms transition. The card lifts 4px with a soft box shadow (Peloton Black at 12% opacity, 0 8px 24px) deepening beneath it. The card heading transitions from Peloton Black to Velodrome Gold in 180ms. The card surface remains Sprint Ivory — no background color change.

CTA Below Cards: 'Explore Performance' — a single text-link CTA, not a button. Placed 40px below the card row, left-aligned to column 1. Montserrat all-caps, 11px, letter-spacing 0.18em, Velodrome Gold (#B89A3E). A thin underline in Velodrome Gold grows from 0 to full width beneath the label on hover (left-to-right, ~150ms). An arrow glyph (→) in Velodrome Gold sits 8px to the right of the label text. This CTA treatment is deliberately restrained — a pointer, not a shout.

Scroll-Triggered Reveal: As the section enters the viewport, the eyebrow and headline fade and slide up 20px together (about 400ms). The Velodrome Gold rule beneath the headline draws left-to-right a beat later. Then the three cards stagger in from left to right — each fades in and slides up 16px, with a quarter-beat delay between each card. The CTA text link fades in last, after all three cards have settled.

Spacing & Padding: 120px top padding, 100px bottom padding. The generous whitespace above and below the grid reinforces the magazine-spread feel.

Responsive: On tablet, cards collapse to a 2-column grid (first two cards in row 1, third card full-width or centered in row 2 — prefer centered at 60% width to avoid a lonely orphan). On mobile, all three cards stack full-width vertically with 24px gaps. The Velodrome Gold left-border rule is preserved at all breakpoints.

**Section 3 — CTA Close: Asymmetric Dark Statement**

Surface & Background: Tarmac Charcoal (#2C2B29) full-bleed — a dark mid-tone that is warmer and less absolute than the hero's Peloton Black. This creates a DARK → LIGHT → DARK rhythm across the page without repeating the same dark surface. The section is compact in height: approximately 300–340px on desktop, giving it the feel of a decisive editorial closing statement rather than a sprawling section.

Layout: The content is left-aligned within the 12-column grid, with a 120px left margin on desktop — matching the hero's left-weighted alignment and creating a consistent left-axis spine across the page. There is no centered composition here; the asymmetry is intentional and reinforces the luxury editorial aesthetic.

Eyebrow: Montserrat all-caps, 11px, letter-spacing 0.18em, Velodrome Gold (#B89A3E), reading 'Join the Journey.' Positioned at the top of the text block with 80px top padding above it.

Headline: 'Ride With Velodyne' in Playfair Display, 56px, font-weight 900, Sprint Ivory (#FAF7F2), line-height 1.08. This is a bold, confident statement — not a question, not a soft invitation. The weight and scale communicate authority. 16px below the eyebrow.

Subheadline: Source Serif 4, 17px, Chamois Warm (#D4C4A8), line-height 1.75, max-width 520px, left-aligned. 'Whether you're a fan, a journalist, or a potential partner — we want to hear from you.' 24px below the headline.

CTAs: Two buttons in a horizontal row, 36px below the subheadline. Primary CTA: 'Get in Touch' — Velodrome Gold (#B89A3E) fill, Peloton Black (#111010) label in Montserrat all-caps 11px, letter-spacing 0.15em, 48px height, 32px horizontal padding. On hover, the primary CTA inverts: Peloton Black fill with Velodrome Gold label and 1px Velodrome Gold border (150ms transition). Secondary CTA: 'Read Our Stories' — transparent fill, 1px Sprint Ivory (#FAF7F2) border, Sprint Ivory label, same Montserrat treatment. On hover, the secondary CTA fills with Sprint Ivory at 12% opacity (150ms transition). The two CTAs are separated by a 24px gap. They sit on the same horizontal row — not stacked — giving the section a compact, resolved quality.

Thin Decorative Rule: A 1px Chamois Warm (#D4C4A8) horizontal rule runs the full width of the content column (columns 1–8) 20px above the eyebrow — a quiet structural separator that signals the section boundary without competing with the headline. This is a restrained ornamental move: thin, calm, magazine-like.

Bottom Padding: 80px below the CTA row, then the footer begins. The compact vertical height and dark surface give this section the feel of a colophon or back-cover statement in a print magazine.

Scroll-Triggered Reveal: The entire section fades in as a unified block with a gentle 20px upward drift as it crosses the viewport threshold — approximately 400ms. No stagger within the section; it arrives as a single composed statement. This is deliberate: after the staggered card grid above, the CTA reads as a resolved, single voice.

Hover on Section Surface: No hover effect on the section background itself — the dark surface is still and authoritative. Only the buttons carry hover affordances.

Responsive: On tablet, headline scales to 44px; max-width of subheadline reduces to 400px. On mobile, headline scales to 36px; CTAs stack vertically, each full-width, with 16px gap between them. Left margin reduces to 24px. The Chamois Warm rule above the eyebrow is preserved at all breakpoints.

pages.page_level_design_instruction:
## Athletes Page — Visual Design Plan

### Page Role & Tone
This is the emotional heart of the Velodyne site — a roster page that must feel less like a directory and more like a luxury sports magazine spread. The page introduces six elite cyclists with depth, character, and editorial gravitas. Every design decision should reinforce the brand's positioning: refined, authoritative, passionate, precise.

---

### Section Sequence & Rhythm

**Section 1 — Page Header (Masthead Editorial):** Opens with a full-bleed dark panel. Sparse, typographically dominant. The headline is set at display scale in Playfair Display, occupying the left two-thirds of the panel with deliberate asymmetric whitespace on the right. A thin Velodrome Gold horizontal rule above the eyebrow grounds the masthead. This section is dense with typographic presence but airy in layout — the luxury editorial paradox.

**Section 2 — Item Grid (Roster Cards):** The page's densest section and its structural core. Six athlete cards arranged in a 3-column grid on desktop, 2-column on tablet, 1-column on mobile. Cards are rich with information hierarchy: a large portrait-format image zone at top, a Velodrome Gold role badge, rider name in Playfair Display H3, discipline/nationality metadata in Montserrat all-caps, and a brief editorial description in Source Serif 4. Cards sit on Sprint Ivory surfaces against a Velodyne Parchment page background, with Chamois Warm border strokes. This section carries the page's **signature moment** (detailed below).

**Section 3 — CTA (Editorial Close):** A narrow, horizontally-oriented dark band — Peloton Black background — with an asymmetric two-column composition: headline and subheadline pushed left, two CTA buttons stacked right. A thin Velodrome Gold rule runs full-width above this section as a structural divider. Deliberately restrained in height — a closing punctuation mark, not a feature.

---

### Signature Moment
**The Oversized Rider Number Backdrop in the Item Grid.** Behind each athlete card's image zone, a massive typographic numeral (the rider's roster number, 01–06) is rendered in Playfair Display at approximately 180–220px, set in Chamois Warm at very low opacity (~12%), bleeding slightly off the right edge of the card. This creates a layered editorial depth — the numeral lives behind the portrait but above the card surface, giving each card a unique, magazine-feature quality. The numerals are not decorative afterthoughts; they are structural anchors that give the grid a sense of serialized narrative, as if each card is a chapter spread. This move is unmistakably luxury editorial — it evokes the numbered athlete spreads of high-end sports publications — and it is calibrated to the aesthetic's calm, premium register: visible but never loud.

**Signature Motion Moment:** On scroll-triggered reveal, each card's oversized numeral fades in from opacity 0 to its resting 12% opacity with a slow, elegant 800ms ease-out — slightly delayed after the card itself appears. The numeral seems to materialize from within the card, as if the editorial layer is settling into place. This is the page's single kinetic signature: restrained, purposeful, tied directly to the visual signature.

---

### Color & Surface Logic
- **Page background:** Velodyne Parchment (#F2EDE4) — warm cream, the editorial base throughout.
- **Section 1 (Header):** Full-bleed Peloton Black (#111010) panel. Headline in Sprint Ivory (#FAF7F2). Eyebrow in Velodrome Gold (#B89A3E) Montserrat all-caps. Subheadline in Criterium Slate (#5A5750).
- **Section 2 (Grid):** Parchment background. Cards on Sprint Ivory (#FAF7F2). Role badge in Velodrome Gold. Card border in Chamois Warm (#D4C4A8). Rider name in Peloton Black. Metadata in Criterium Slate. Oversized numeral in Chamois Warm at low opacity.
- **Section 3 (CTA):** Full-bleed Peloton Black. Eyebrow in Velodrome Gold. Headline in Sprint Ivory. Subheadline in Criterium Slate. Primary CTA in Velodrome Gold with Peloton Black text. Secondary CTA as ghost/outline in Sprint Ivory.
- Velodrome Gold appears in eyebrow labels, role badges, CTA buttons, and the thin structural rules — it is the prestige signal threaded consistently through the page without overuse.

---

### Typographic Hierarchy
- **H1 (Section 1 headline):** Playfair Display, 72–80px, weight 800, Sprint Ivory, line-height 1.08, sentence case, left-aligned.
- **Eyebrow labels:** Montserrat, all-caps, 11px, 0.18em letter-spacing, Velodrome Gold.
- **Section 2 headline ("Meet the Team"):** Playfair Display, 42–48px, weight 700, Peloton Black, left-aligned above the grid.
- **Card rider names (H3):** Playfair Display, 28–32px, weight 700, Peloton Black.
- **Card role badge:** Montserrat, all-caps, 10px, 0.20em letter-spacing, Velodrome Gold on Peloton Black pill.
- **Card description body:** Source Serif 4, 15–16px, Criterium Slate, line-height 1.7.
- **Card metadata (nationality/discipline):** Montserrat, all-caps, 10px, Chamois Warm, 0.15em letter-spacing.
- **Section 3 headline:** Playfair Display, 42–48px, Sprint Ivory, weight 700.
- **Section 3 subheadline:** Source Serif 4, 17px, Criterium Slate.
- **CTA labels:** Montserrat, all-caps, 12px, 0.15em letter-spacing.

---

### Density & Whitespace Logic
Section 1 is generous — tall vertical padding (120px top, 100px bottom), the headline given room to breathe on a dark field. Section 2 is the densest zone: the grid cards are substantial in height but the gutters between them are 28–32px, maintaining the editorial breathing room. Section 3 is narrow and tight — 72px vertical padding — a composed, purposeful close. The overall page rhythm reads: expansive → structured density → compressed close.

---

### Motion Design (Luxury Editorial Calibration: 2–3 Restrained Moments)

**On-Load Arc (Section 1):**
- The Peloton Black header panel is present immediately on load — no fade, no sweep. The dark surface lands with authority.
- The eyebrow label (Montserrat, Velodrome Gold) fades in first, gently, over about 400ms.
- A beat after the eyebrow settles, the headline slides up from 20px below its resting position and fades in — a single, elegant entrance over 600ms.
- The subheadline follows a beat later with the same slide-up fade, slightly slower (700ms), reinforcing the staggered editorial reveal.
- The thin Velodrome Gold rule above the eyebrow draws in from left to right, completing its traverse as the eyebrow fades in.

**Scroll-Triggered Reveals (Section 2):**
- The "Meet the Team" headline and eyebrow fade up as the section enters the viewport.
- The six athlete cards stagger in from bottom (each offset by ~80ms), fading and rising 16px — a gentle cascade that reads left-to-right, top-to-bottom.
- The **signature motion moment**: each card's oversized background numeral fades in from opacity 0 to its resting 12% opacity with an 800ms ease-out, delayed by ~200ms after its parent card appears. The numeral materializes softly, as if settling into the editorial layer.
- Section 3 CTA band slides up 12px and fades in as a single unit when it enters the viewport — no stagger, it arrives as one composed block.

**Hover Affordances:**
- Athlete cards: on hover, the card lifts 5px, the Chamois Warm border strokes shift to Velodrome Gold, and the rider name shifts from Peloton Black to Velodrome Gold — a warm, prestigious color transition over ~200ms. The oversized numeral behind the image subtly increases to ~18% opacity on hover, adding a sense of depth surfacing.
- CTA buttons: the primary Velodrome Gold button darkens slightly and the text shifts to Sprint Ivory on hover, with a 150ms transition. The ghost secondary button fills with a very subtle Sprint Ivory tint at 10% opacity.
- Navigation items retain their system-wide hover behavior (thin Velodrome Gold underline grows from left).

**Ambient Motion:**
- None. The luxury editorial register demands stillness as the ambient state. The page is calm, magazine-like. No pulses, no drifts, no marquees on this page. Motion is reserved for meaningful moments only.

---

### Responsive Behavior
- **Desktop (1280px+):** 3-column card grid. Header text at full display scale. Section 3 two-column horizontal split.

## Performance Page — Visual Design Direction

### Page Identity & Narrative Arc
The Performance page is Velodyne's proof-of-concept document — a magazine-spread that reads like a scientific dossier rendered in the vocabulary of a luxury cycling publication. The page moves from a masthead-style editorial header (sparse, typographically dominant) into a full-bleed stat block that is the page's signature moment, then closes with a disciplined three-column feature grid that earns its CTA. The rhythm alternates: sparse → dense → structured — deliberately avoiding the trap of three identical section skeletons.

### Signature Moment
The **Stats section (Section 2)** is the page's defining visual event. The four performance figures — "18", "340,000 km", "6.4 W/kg", "94%" — are rendered as oversized Playfair Display numerals at 120–160px, set in Velodrome Gold (#B89A3E) against a full-bleed Peloton Black (#111010) panel. The numerals are not contained inside cards — they are typographic monuments that sit flush to the grid edges with their descriptive copy set in small Montserrat beneath, creating a dramatic weight-contrast moment that reads as a double-page magazine spread. This is the luxury editorial signature: type-as-image, where the data itself becomes the art direction. No illustration, no photography — only the numbers, the serif weight contrast, and the gold-on-black field.

### Section Sequence & Rhythm
1. **Page Header (Section 1):** Sprint Ivory (#FAF7F2) background, left-anchored asymmetric layout, maximum whitespace, thin Chamois Warm horizontal rule below the eyebrow. Very sparse — the page breathes before it performs.
2. **Stats (Section 2):** Full-bleed Peloton Black panel — the page's tonal and visual rupture. Oversized gold numerals dominate. Dense with data but spacious in its typographic scale. The color inversion (dark panel after light header) signals the shift from editorial framing to hard evidence.
3. **Feature Grid (Section 3):** Returns to Velodyne Parchment (#F2EDE4) base, three structured cards on Tarmac Charcoal (#2C2B29) surfaces, closing with a Velodrome Gold CTA. The grid restores order and editorial calm after the intensity of the stats panel.

### Color & Surface Logic
- Section 1: Sprint Ivory background, Peloton Black type, Chamois Warm rule, Velodrome Gold eyebrow label.
- Section 2: Peloton Black full-bleed, Velodrome Gold for stat numerals, Sprint Ivory for stat descriptions, Criterium Slate (#5A5750) for unit labels, thin Chamois Warm rules separating stat cells.
- Section 3: Velodyne Parchment base, Tarmac Charcoal card surfaces, Chamois Warm card borders, Sprint Ivory body copy on cards, Velodrome Gold CTA and hover accents.

### Typography Hierarchy
- Section 1 headline: Playfair Display, 72–80px, weight 800, Peloton Black, sentence case, line-height 1.08.
- Section 2 stat numerals: Playfair Display, 120–160px, weight 900, Velodrome Gold — these are display-scale typographic objects, not data labels.
- Section 2 section headline: Playfair Display, 42px, Sprint Ivory, centered above the stat row.
- Section 3 card headlines: Playfair Display, 28–32px, Sprint Ivory on Tarmac Charcoal.
- All eyebrow labels: Montserrat, 11px, all-caps, 0.18em letter-spacing, Velodrome Gold.
- All body/description copy: Source Serif 4, 16–17px, 1.75 line-height, appropriate surface contrast color.

### Density & Whitespace Logic
Section 1 is deliberately spare — 120px top padding, the headline taking up roughly 60% of the viewport width, the subheadline set at a narrow 540px measure to the left. The whitespace to the right is intentional negative space, not a placeholder for an image. Section 2 is dense with typographic mass but not cluttered — the numerals need room to breathe at their scale (each stat cell is roughly 25% of the container width). Section 3 returns to editorial calm with generous card padding (40–48px internal) and 24px gutters between the three columns.

### Motion Design

**On-load arc:**
The page arrives quietly. The eyebrow label in Section 1 fades in first — a single word materializing. A beat later, the headline slides up from 20px below its resting position and fades to full opacity over a slow, unhurried duration. The subheadline follows a half-beat after the headline settles, appearing at lower opacity and easing in. The thin Chamois Warm rule beneath the eyebrow draws itself from left to right in a slow line-draw animation that completes just as the headline finishes its entrance. The overall on-load feel is composed, not urgent — a magazine page turning.

**Scroll-triggered reveals:**
- Section 2 (Stats): As the black panel enters the viewport, the section headline fades up first. Then the four stat numerals count up from zero to their final values — "18" counts quickly, "340,000 km" counts in large increments, "6.4 W/kg" ticks up in tenths, "94%" counts in whole numbers. This is the **signature motion moment** — the gold numerals animate as live performance data resolving in real time, reinforcing the team's data-driven identity. Each numeral's description line fades in a beat after its number reaches its final value, staggered left-to-right.
- Section 3 (Feature Grid): The three cards slide up from 30px below and fade in with a left-to-right stagger — first card, then second, then third, each a short beat apart. The CTA fades in last, after all three cards have settled.

**Hover affordances:**
- Section 3 cards: On hover, the card surface lifts 4px (subtle translateY), the Chamois Warm border shifts to Velodrome Gold, and the card headline transitions from Sprint Ivory to Velodrome Gold. The transition is quick and precise — not bouncy, not elastic. Keyboard focus mirrors the hover state with a visible Velodrome Gold outline.
- CTA button: On hover, the Velodrome Gold background deepens slightly toward a richer amber, and the label shifts to Peloton Black. A thin underline grows from left to right beneath the label text on hover.

**Ambient looped motion:**
The thin Chamois Warm horizontal rule in Section 1 has a very slow, barely perceptible shimmer — a single point of light traveling along it from left to right on a long loop (every 6–8 seconds), like a reflection on a tensioned wire. This is restrained and nearly subliminal, consistent with the luxury editorial register. No marquees, no pulsing — the page is composed, not restless.

**Motion calibration:** Luxury editorial — 2–3 restrained moments plus the signature counter animation. All transitions use slow, deliberate easing. Nothing bounces or overshoots. The signature motion moment (counting numerals) is the page's one kinetic flourish.

### Responsive Behavior
- Mobile (< 768px): Section 1 headline scales to 48–56px, subheadline to full width. Section 2 stats stack in a 2×2 grid, numerals scale to 80–96px. Section 3 cards stack vertically in a single column. All horizontal rules and thin rules remain visible.
- Tablet (768–1024px): Section 2 stats remain in a 4-column row at reduced numeral size (96–110px). Section 3 cards in 2+1 or 3-column depending on breakpoint.
- Desktop (≥ 1280px): Full layouts as described — Section 1 asymmetric left-anchored, Section 2 4-column stat row, Section 3 3-column card grid.

### Fit Within Shared Design System
This page uses the full palette expressively: Peloton Black as a full-bleed surface (not just text), Velodrome Gold as a typographic color at display scale (not just CTA buttons), Chamois Warm as structural ornament (rule lines, borders), Tarmac Charcoal as card surfaces. Playfair Display is pushed to its maximum display weight to honor the heading_treatment spec. The page is the most data-forward in the site, and the design reflects that — the luxury register is maintained not through decoration but through typographic scale, restraint in ornamentation, and the deliberate use of negative space as a design material.

## Stories Page — Visual Design Direction

### Page Role & Tone
The Stories page is Velodyne's editorial heart — a cycling team's journal told with the authority of a premium sports magazine. Every decision here should evoke the physical sensation of opening a beautifully printed publication: cream paper weight, ink-black headlines, gold rule accents, and photography that bleeds past the margin. The page must feel curated, not algorithmic. Browsing it should feel like turning pages, not scrolling a feed.

### Section Sequence & Rhythm
Three sections in deliberate density contrast:
1. **Page Header** — Sparse, masthead-style. Maximum whitespace, typographic dominance, almost no decoration. Sets the editorial register immediately.
2. **Article List (Card Grid)** — Dense, modular, richly varied. The page's primary content mass. Four editorial cards in an asymmetric grid with deliberate weight variation between them.
3. **CTA Close** — Calm, full-bleed dark panel. Typographic and spatial compression after the card grid's density. A composed, authoritative close.

The rhythm is: open → dense → close. This mirrors the experience of a magazine: a commanding cover spread, a rich interior feature well, and a final editorial sign-off.

### Signature Moment
**The Article List section opens with an oversized, partially clipped display numeral "04" — the issue/volume signal — set in Playfair Display at approximately 280–320px, in Velodrome Gold (#B89A3E), positioned behind the section headline and left-aligned, bleeding off the left edge of the content column.** This is the page's typographic stunt and its most unmistakably luxury-editorial gesture. It signals "four stories" while functioning as pure decorative architecture — the kind of oversized numeral that appears in the margins of Monocle, Vogue, or L'Équipe's premium supplements. It belongs to this aesthetic because it is simultaneously structural and ornamental, restrained in color (gold, not red), and never competes with the content — it recedes behind the headline like a watermark, present only to those who look for it.

### Signature Motion Moment
**As the Article List section enters the viewport, the oversized "04" numeral fades up from 0 opacity to approximately 30% opacity — slowly, over roughly 1.5 seconds — while the section headline slides in from slightly below. The numeral settles first, then the headline arrives on top of it, creating the layered depth effect.** This motion makes the editorial architecture feel discovered rather than announced, which is precisely the luxury register.

### Color & Surface Logic
- **Page background throughout**: Velodyne Parchment (#F2EDE4) — the warm cream base that reads as premium magazine paper.
- **Section 1 (Header)**: Parchment background, Peloton Black type. No card surfaces. Pure editorial whitespace.
- **Section 2 (Article List)**: Parchment base with cards surfaced in Sprint Ivory (#FAF7F2) — the lighter lift. One featured card (the lead story) uses a Peloton Black (#111010) dark surface with Sprint Ivory and Velodrome Gold type, creating deliberate contrast within the grid. Thin Chamois Warm (#D4C4A8) rules separate metadata from headline within cards.
- **Section 3 (CTA)**: Full-bleed Tarmac Charcoal (#2C2B29) panel. Sprint Ivory headline, Velodrome Gold eyebrow and accent rule. This dark close anchors the page and prevents the cream-heavy editorial middle from feeling unresolved.

### Typographic Hierarchy
- **H1 (Page Header headline)**: Playfair Display, 72–80px, weight 800, Peloton Black, sentence case, tight line-height ~1.05. Left-aligned, not centered.
- **Eyebrow labels**: Montserrat, all-caps, 11px, 0.18em letter-spacing, Velodrome Gold on dark surfaces, Criterium Slate (#5A5750) on light surfaces.
- **Section H2**: Playfair Display, 42–48px, weight 700, Peloton Black, left-aligned.
- **Card H3**: Playfair Display, 28–32px, weight 700. Dark card uses Sprint Ivory; light cards use Peloton Black.
- **Card body/description**: Source Serif 4, 16px, 1.75 line-height, Criterium Slate on light cards, Chamois Warm on dark card.
- **Metadata (category, date)**: Montserrat, all-caps, 10px, 0.20em letter-spacing, Criterium Slate or Chamois Warm.
- **CTA headline**: Playfair Display, 52–60px, Sprint Ivory, weight 800.
- **CTA subheadline**: Source Serif 4, 18px, Chamois Warm, italic.

### Density & Whitespace Logic
Section 1 is intentionally sparse — generous top padding (~120px), the eyebrow and headline occupy the left two-thirds of the page, with the right third holding only a thin vertical Chamois Warm rule as a structural accent. Section 2 is the page's dense core: four cards in an asymmetric grid with consistent internal padding but varied card heights. Section 3 returns to spacious padding (~100px vertical) with centered text composition — the only centered block on the page, justified by the aesthetic convention of a dark editorial close.

### Motion Design
**On-load arc (Section 1):**
- The eyebrow label fades in first, sliding up gently from 12px below its resting position.
- A beat later, the headline arrives with a slightly longer slide-up from 20px below — Playfair Display at display scale deserves a moment to settle.
- The subheadline and thin vertical rule fade in together after the headline has landed.
- The thin horizontal rule beneath the header block draws left-to-right (a line-draw animation) as the final on-load gesture.

**Scroll-triggered reveals (Section 2):**
- The oversized "04" numeral fades up to its ambient opacity (~30%) as the section enters the viewport — this is the signature motion moment.
- The section eyebrow and headline slide up a beat after the numeral begins its fade.
- The four article cards stagger in from bottom (each offset by roughly half a beat), left-to-right in reading order, so the grid assembles itself progressively rather than appearing all at once.

**Scroll-triggered reveals (Section 3):**
- The full-bleed dark panel fades in as a surface, then the Velodrome Gold rule draws left-to-right, then the headline slides up, then the two CTA buttons fade in together.

**Hover affordances:**
- Article cards: on hover, the card lifts 4px with a gentle shadow deepening (shadow spreads from 0 to a soft 12px diffuse shadow in Peloton Black at low opacity). The article headline shifts from Peloton Black to Velodrome Gold on light cards, and from Sprint Ivory to Velodrome Gold on the dark card. Transition is smooth and quick — roughly 180ms.
- CTA buttons: the primary "Contact the Team" button (Velodrome Gold fill, Peloton Black text) brightens slightly on hover and lifts 2px. The secondary "Explore the Roster" button (outlined) fills with Velodrome Gold on hover with a smooth color flood from left-to-right (a sliding fill effect).
- Navigation items retain the system's standard Velodrome Gold underline-grow hover.

**Ambient looped motion:**
- The thin horizontal rule beneath the page header has a very slow, subtle shimmer — a gold highlight passes across it from left to right every ~8 seconds, barely perceptible, reinforcing the Velodrome Gold accent without demanding attention. This is the page's only ambient loop, calibrated to the luxury editorial register (restrained, not kinetic).

### Responsive Behavior
- **Desktop (1280px+)**: Full asymmetric card grid (lead card spanning ~60% width, three secondary cards in a 3-column row beneath), oversized "04" numeral fully visible.
- **Tablet (768–1279px)**: Lead card full-width, three secondary cards in a 2+1 arrangement. Oversized numeral scales down to ~180px and clips less aggressively.
- **Mobile (<768px)**: All cards stack single-column. Oversized numeral reduces to ~120px and sits above the section headline rather than behind it. Page header headline drops to ~48px. CTA section centers its text and stacks buttons vertically.

### Cross-Page Fit
The Stories page shares the Parchment base, Peloton Black typographic authority, Velodrome Gold accent logic, and Playfair Display headline scale with the rest of the site. Its distinction within the system is the editorial card grid's asymmetry, the oversized numeral signature, and the deliberate magazine-pacing of its three-section rhythm — denser in its content section than the Athletes or Home pages, more typographically playful in its structural decoration.

pages.page_level_design_instruction:
The Contact page for Velodyne operates as the team's most intimate editorial statement — a page where luxury restraint meets genuine openness. The page unfolds in three distinct rhythmic beats: a masthead-style page header that commands the full viewport width with dramatic typographic scale; a card grid inquiry-routing section that channels the layout family's modular logic through editorial refinement; and a dense, split contact block that grounds the experience in tactile detail and direct utility.

SURFACE & COLOR LOGIC: The page opens on Peloton Black (#111010) — a full-bleed dark header that signals authority and warmth simultaneously. The second section lifts to Velodyne Parchment (#F2EDE4) as the base, with Sprint Ivory (#FAF7F2) card surfaces floating above it. The third section returns to a Tarmac Charcoal (#2C2B29) left panel paired with Sprint Ivory (#FAF7F2) on the right, creating a structural split that echoes the team's dual identity: precision and elegance. Velodrome Gold (#B89A3E) appears as an ornamental rule accent in the header, as card hover borders in the grid, and as the CTA button fill in the contact block — never merely decorative, always load-bearing.

TYPOGRAPHIC HIERARCHY: Playfair Display dominates at display scale throughout. The headline "Let's Talk" in section one is the typographic event of the page — set at 96px, sentence case, font-weight 900, with extreme stroke contrast exploited at maximum size. Montserrat eyebrow labels appear in all-caps at 11px with 0.18em letter-spacing above every section headline, functioning as the editorial tab system. Source Serif 4 handles all body copy and card descriptions at 17px, 1.75 line-height. Card titles use Playfair Display at 28px, weight 700.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The page's signature visual moment lives in Section 1 — the word "Talk" in the headline "Let's Talk" is set at a dramatically oversized scale (120–140px on desktop), breaking below the baseline of "Let's" and bleeding slightly past the right grid margin, with a single hairline Velodrome Gold rule (1px) running horizontally beneath the full headline block, extending edge-to-edge across the dark panel. This typographic stunt — a display word that overflows its own container — is the defining luxury editorial move of the page: it signals that Velodyne treats communication itself as a statement of confidence. The word does not sit politely; it asserts.

SIGNATURE MOTION MOMENT: On page load, "Let's" fades and settles first at full opacity, then "Talk" slides up from 30px below its final position and scales very slightly from 0.96 to 1.0 over a slow, deliberate duration — arriving with weight, as if the word is landing on the page rather than appearing on it. The hairline gold rule beneath then draws itself left-to-right over roughly one second, completing the typographic composition. This entrance sequence is the signature motion moment: restrained, inevitable, and unmistakably editorial.

ON-LOAD ARC: The Peloton Black header panel fades in first as a full surface. A beat later, the Montserrat eyebrow "Get in Touch" appears at low opacity and slides up 12px. A beat after that, "Let's" settles into position. Then "Talk" arrives with its signature slide-up-and-scale. The gold rule draws itself left to right. The subheadline fades in last, softly, with no movement — just opacity. The entire arc completes within the first three seconds of the page load.

SCROLL-TRIGGERED REVEALS: Section 2 cards stagger in as the section enters the viewport — the section headline fades and slides up first, then the three cards enter left-to-right with a 120ms stagger between each, each sliding up 20px from its resting position. Section 3 reveals the left dark panel and right form panel simultaneously as a split — both slide in from their respective sides (left panel from the left, right panel from the right) over a smooth, unhurried duration, meeting in the center as if the page is opening a book.

HOVER AFFORDANCES: In Section 2, each inquiry card lifts 4px on hover with a Velodrome Gold border stroke appearing around the card edge and the email address shifting from Criterium Slate to Velodrome Gold. In Section 3, the Submit Inquiry button fills from Velodrome Gold to a slightly deeper gold tone on hover, with the label tracking out 0.05em. All interactive email links underline with a Race Red (#9B2A2A) underline on hover — a selective urgency signal.

AMBIENT MOTION: A very slow, barely perceptible parallax drift on the header panel — the background surface (pure Peloton Black) remains fixed while the typographic content scrolls at 0.85x the scroll rate, creating a subtle depth sensation as the user begins to scroll away from the header. This is the only ambient motion on the page — calibrated to the luxury editorial register where stillness is a virtue.

DENSITY & WHITESPACE LOGIC: Section 1 is sparse and commanding — large type, generous vertical padding (120px top, 100px bottom), asymmetric alignment (headline left-aligned, not centered). Section 2 is modular and airy — three cards in a three-column grid with 32px gutters, 80px vertical padding above and below. Section 3 is the densest — a two-column split (left: 40% dark panel with contact details; right: 60% form area) with tighter internal padding, creating the sensation of a premium printed form insert inside a magazine.

RESPONSIVE BEHAVIOR: On tablet (768–1024px), Section 2 collapses to a two-column grid with the third card spanning full width below. Section 3 stacks vertically — dark contact details panel above, form below. On mobile (<768px), all sections are single-column. The Section 1 headline reduces to 64px for "Talk" and 48px for "Let's" on mobile, maintaining the scale differential. The gold rule remains full-bleed at all breakpoints.

CROSS-PAGE RHYTHM: This page closes the five-page Velodyne site with the same Peloton Black opening used on the Home hero, creating a bookend rhythm. The card grid in Section 2 echoes the Athletes page roster grid and the Stories article grid — maintaining the modular vocabulary. The contact block's dark/light split echoes the Performance page's stat block treatment, completing the design system's internal coherence.
